name: Suzhou Secote Precision Electronic Co.,LTD
summary: Suzhou Secote Precision Electronic Co.,LTD provides automation solutions in the People's Republic of China. It offers measurement and detection equipment and fixtures. The company also provides micro size label labeling machine for consumer electronics; upscale lipstick case assembly line for cosmetics; frozen food packaging line; flu test stick assembly line; shoes automatic packaging line; automotive engine ims assembly line; and solutions for the laser industry. Its products are used in consumer electronics, automotive, medical, household appliance, apparel and personal care, food service, and cosmetics industries.
